decision_rule: Require recoverable public prompt-size windows at two or more proxies; then recover 3/3 rows after one explicit context failure, never split ordinary or single-row failures, preserve the 25-call hard cap, pass all tests, and keep all public offline outputs byte-identical.
hypothesis: A batch-local context-limit failure can often be recovered by retrying its rows individually within the existing request and deadline caps.
reason: All three proxy ceilings expose public recovery opportunities; deterministic fault injection recovers every row only for explicit multi-row context errors, preserves all global bounds and normal paths, and leaves all public offline bytes unchanged.

size_screen.caveat: Character limits are deterministic context proxies; no authoritative House token ceiling is published.

validation.smoke_basis: Candidate offline bytes equal the f948922 baseline already verified by toolkit 2.4.4.
